verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a pip install, a quickstart guide, demo apps in the claude-agent-sdk-demos repo, Cookbook recipes, and the general Claude Code CLI reference. None of these documents a one-command scaffolding CLI or official project template that generates a new agent project. Example repos and package installs are adjacent building blocks, not the scaffolding capability itself.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have a coding agent scaffold a new agent project from an official CLI or template in one command
